rules.statement: Submit exactly one `gaps` entry, by its `gap_id`, for every gap on the CP-0 agenda (`gaps` of the module context), none twice and none for an id the agenda does not list, each with one to four `questions`; when the agenda is empty, `gaps` is empty.
Every `question_id` is different from every other in the whole submission, and at most 145 characters, since fact ids are composed from it.

An `answered` question has an `answer`, a `category` and at least one citation, and a null `limitation`. A `not_found` question has a null `answer` and `category`, no citations, and states its `limitation`.

Each question lists in `searched_sources` at least one ready prepared source (see `sources` of the module context); before you claim `not_found` for a source, run `search_pack` on that source, or the claim is refused as an absence with no recorded search.
Cite only pack sources whose cited page you read with `read_pages`, each quote verbatim under its locator; a source outside the pack is refused.

A question's `text`, `answer` and `limitation` are nonblank, contain no digit or figure, no braces or brackets, and none of the words recommend, refinanc, covenant or recovery in any case; an answer is plain text with no reference.
